description: This file is a Python script demonstrating the use of Spark's BucketedRandomProjectionLSH for approximate similarity joins and nearest neighbor searches, including data setup, model training, and example queries.

classes.name: BucketedRandomProjectionLSH
classes.description: A Spark ML feature transformer for Locality Sensitive Hashing using bucketed random projections.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Fits the BucketedRandomProjectionLSH model to the input DataFrame.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the input DataFrame by adding hash columns.

methods.name: approxSimilarityJoin
methods.description: Performs an approximate similarity join between two DataFrames based on Euclidean distance.

methods.name: approxNearestNeighbors
methods.description: Finds approximate nearest neighbors for a given key in a DataFrame.
